  Skipped: nothing about the invoice varies per place beyond name/address — amounts, supplier and line items are fixed like the attestation's are. Add inputs to the place file when a door needs different ones.

  Two things worth your call:
  - The signature scan has "Jean Dupont / Gérant" baked in, and both documents were re-typesetting that under the image. I dropped the repeat rather than the image — check the rendering agrees with what you wanted there.
  - TVA at 20 % assumes the SCI opted to tax the lease; a non-opted SCI would bill rent exempt. Say the word and it becomes an exempt invoice with the TVA non applicable mention instead.
